sentence: Up to four face-to-face meetings are likely between the leaders of the world’s two largest economies.
A grand spectacle is almost guaranteed when President Donald Trump hosts his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping for the latter’s first visit to the US capital in 11 years.
Trump plans to personally receive Xi when he lands on Sept 23 at Joint Base Andrews, just outside Washington, for the second presidential summit of 2026.
The Trump-Xi summit at the White House on Sept 24 will be capped by a gala dinner with top tech and finance chiefs in attendance.

Tensions could ratchet up a day before Xi’s arrival, when Trump addresses the United Nations General Assembly, where he is expected to talk about his next moves as the Iran war enters its seventh month.

His speech will be watched to see if he holds China to account over reports that it had provided Iran with high-resolution satellite imagery allegedly used to target a US base in Jordan in a July 15 attack that killed three US soldiers.
